reviews.text:
I am writing to express my strong disappointment regarding my recent stay. As a Diamond Elite member, I expect a standard of service and hospitality that reflects loyalty and status, but my recent experience fell far short.
​Check-In & Recognition: The welcome experience was entirely lacking. I was simply handed my key card without the customary hospitality or warmth expected for Diamond members.
​Suite Upgrade Handling: Upon requesting an upgrade, I was flatly denied despite suites showing availability. This is not an isolated incident—it has happened repeatedly during past stays. It strongly felt as though foreign nationals were being prioritized over local Indian guests for upgrades and attentive service.
​Severe Dining Hygiene Issues: The breakfast service was deeply concerning. I observed non-vegetarian and vegetarian items in direct physical contact with each other, with omelets and dosas literally overlapping on the cooking line. Cross-contamination of this nature is completely unacceptable, and as a result, I was forced to skip breakfast entirely.
​Room Layout: The room was acceptable, though notably congested for a premium tier experience.
​As a loyal member, I expect my status to be respected and basic food hygiene standards to be strictly enforced.

reviews.text:
Very disappointing parking policy by Hilton.

I came to the hotel to drop a guest. I had a private car with a driver, but the hotel refused to allow the car to be parked because the driver was present. They said parking is allowed only if the guest comes without a driver.

If the car belongs to the guest and the guest is staying at the hotel, why should having a driver make the car ineligible for parking? This makes absolutely no sense.

When I parked the car outside, traffic police came and told us to park the car at the place we were visiting — which was Hilton itself. But Hilton’s management refused to allow the car inside.

A hotel of Hilton’s standard should have a much more sensible and guest-friendly parking policy. This entire experience was unnecessarily frustrating and embarrassing.

Shame on Hilton management for such a ridiculous policy.

I had a wonderful stay at the Hilton Mumbai International Airport with my wife and child, and I would like to sincerely appreciate the exceptional hospitality we received throughout our visit.
A special thank you to Mr. Gaurav at the reception, who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. I would also like to express my sincere appreciation to Ms. Tanya and Ms. Amarpreet in the dining area. Both were incredibly kind, supportive, attentive, and prompt in their service. Their positive attitude and genuine care made every dining experience enjoyable and welcoming.
Mr. Aman in the dining area has been very prompt taking care of all the diners with a sweet smile.
It is employees like Gaurav, Tanya, Amarpreet and Aman who truly represent the spirit of Hilton hospitality. Their professionalism, dedication, and personal touch deserve recognition and appreciation.
Thank you to the entire team for making our family stay memorable. Keep up the excellent work—you are a wonderful asset to Hilton! I would be happy to return and highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for outstanding hospitality in Mumbai.

Currently staying at the prestigious Hilton International Mumbai, room 317. This is my first visit to the city as a frequent traveler, and unfortunately, it has been so disappointing that I definitely won't be returning.

Full marks to the breakfast team—the food was excellent, and the staff there were warm, attentive, and professional. Sadly, that's where the positive experience ends.

From 9:00 a.m. onwards, there was continuous hammering noise that went on throughout the day. Due to the incessant rains, I had no choice but to remain in my room, making the experience unbearable. What was even more disappointing was that this wasn't a one-off incident—it happened for two consecutive days.

Despite repeated reminders and complaints, no one bothered to check if the issue had been resolved or even whether I was comfortable. The complete lack of follow-up and concern for a guest's experience is unacceptable, especially from a hotel that prides itself on its reputation.

I rarely take time out of a busy day to write reviews while I'm still staying at a property, but the level of service I experienced truly warrants one. I expected far better from Hilton, and this stay has been a major disappointment.

Our experience at the Grand Hyatt Mumbai was absolutely terrible from the moment we arrived.

Firstly, when we checked in at around 4pm, the receptionist who attended to us looked visibly tired and exhausted. There was no warmth, energy or welcoming attitude whatsoever. For a hotel of this standard, the first impression was incredibly underwhelming.

Things only got worse after we were given our rooms. We dropped off our bags and immediately headed out. When we returned later, we walked into an unbearable smell of dampness and fresh paint. The smell was so overwhelmingly strong that our eyes actually started burning.

What made this even more unacceptable was that the smell was not there when we initially entered the room and dropped off our bags. It became obvious that they had decided to carry out painting or maintenance work while we were already checked into and assigned the room.

How can a five-star hotel knowingly expose paying guests to such strong paint fumes? Carrying out painting work in or around an occupied guest room and then expecting guests to sleep in those conditions is completely unacceptable. The room was not fit to stay in, let alone sleep in.

For a Grand Hyatt property, this level of service and basic consideration for guests is honestly shocking. We expected a luxury hotel experience and instead were greeted by exhausted staff and a room filled with damp, toxic-smelling paint fumes that literally caused our eyes to burn.

A hugely disappointing experience and certainly not what you would expect from a supposedly five-star hotel.

My recent stay at the Grand Hyatt did not meet expected brand standards.

The breakfast service was notably poor, with staff appearing disengaged and inattentive. Guests were not proactively assisted, and basic service such as checking on needs was lacking. A pretty lame customer experience for me.

At the front desk, I inquired about parking charges but received no clear answer. Despite follow-ups, I was not provided with the information during my stay.

Room product  felt outdated, particularly in terms of power outlets, which did not meet the needs of international travelers. Minimal customization of amenities.

I would be hesitant to recommend this property based on my experience.

The food was one of the biggest letdowns. Considering the prices, we expected much better quality, but the food we ordered was extremely disappointing and nowhere close to what you would expect from a five-star property.

The property is not maintained.

We came here hoping to make our birthday vacation special, but sadly, the experience did not live up to our expectations.

We stayed at Trident BKC for my mom’s visa interview, and the experience was truly exceptional. Although it was an expensive stay, for our purpose it was absolutely worth the money  quality, comfort, convenience, and most importantly, the incredible hospitality of the staff.

My mom’s visa interview was scheduled very early at 7:00 AM, and one of the biggest advantages of staying here was being so close to the U.S. Consulate. From our room, we could actually see the lines forming outside in the morning, which took away so much of the stress of having to travel across Mumbai for such an important appointment.

Her interview process took much longer than expected, and she did not come out until around 11:00 AM, so our family ended up missing breakfast. When the hotel staff learned about our situation, they very kindly arranged breakfast for us in our room even though breakfast hours had already ended. That gesture alone meant a lot to us after such a stressful morning.

But what made the stay truly unforgettable was Shraddha, the manager. Before checkout, she personally came to our room to ask how our stay had been. At almost that exact moment, I was on the phone with my husband, who was waiting outside the Consulate for my mom. From the hotel, I could see my mom finally coming out, and we learned that her visa had been approved. It was such an emotional and happy moment for our family.

Shraddha understood what was happening and immediately asked if the hotel could arrange a small surprise for us. She requested that I give them a little time, and shortly afterward they had arranged floating balloons, a beautiful flower bouquet, and our missed breakfast in the room.

What started as a stay for a stressful visa interview suddenly turned into a beautiful visa celebration at Trident BKC. My mom was downstairs at the time, so everything was ready when she came back. We were able to celebrate her visa approval together right there in the hotel, and it became one of the most memorable parts of our entire experience.

It turned an already unforgettable day into something magical for our entire family. After all the anticipation and stress surrounding the visa interview, being able to celebrate such an important milestone together at Trident was incredibly special.

A huge thank you to Shraddha and the entire Trident BKC team for going far beyond what we expected. Their kindness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail are something we will always remember.

For anyone coming to Mumbai for an early-morning appointment at the U.S. Consulate, especially for something as important and stressful as a visa interview, I would highly recommend staying here. Excellent location, excellent comfort, outstanding service and hospitality with a genuinely human touch.

We came to Trident for a visa interview and left with a beautiful visa celebration and memories we will cherish forever. Worth every penny for us. ❤️

We had a wonderful two night stay at The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake. It was extremely comfortable, and we felt very well taken care of throughout our stay.

The staff, service and facilities at the hotel are incredible. I genuinely feel that this property has one of the finest swimming pools and gyms among Mumbai hotels.

What made our stay even more special was the staff. Everyone was so warm, sweet and helpful. They took care of everything, from the smallest details, like specially arranging a particular tea for us, to checking on us every time we entered the hotel. These thoughtful gestures really made an impact.

The food was also amazing. We loved the breakfast spread at Lake View Café, which was one of the highlights of our stay. We also had a lovely meal at Mayouchi, the Japanese restaurant.

A special thank you to Prachi Rane, Chirag managing the restaurants and Laxmi from Lounge for going out of your way to check on us and make sure we were comfortable.

Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so memorable. We would love to come back!

reviews.text:
I stayed at The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake recently and had a really good experience. The location is definitely its biggest selling point. It sits right on the edge of Powai Lake, offering a peaceful, green escape from the usual Mumbai hustle.
Here is what stood out during my stay:

* The Rooms: Spacious, clean, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. If you book, try to get a lake-view room. Waking up to the water and greenery makes a huge difference.
* Service: The staff was genuinely warm and helpful. Check-in was smooth, and they were quick to assist with any small requests.
* Food: The breakfast spread was massive and excellent, featuring a great mix of local Indian dishes and international options.
* Amenities: The property is beautiful to walk around. The pool area is well-maintained and serves as a great spot to unwind in the evening.

Overall, it is a fantastic property for a business trip or a relaxing staycation. I would definitely head back.

reviews.text:
ITC Maratha #SamsTravelogy Rating 4/5
Location - 5 mins Drive from Terminal 2 Mumbai Airport
Welcome - Greeted well on arrival by Yuvna and her front desk team.
Atmosphere - This hotel is a beautiful blend of modern & heritage architecture. The central pavilion is grand and is the highlight of the property.
Room - We booked the ITC one room. The room was very spacious & well laid out. Everything was tidy including the linens. But the rooms are now showing their age and needs refurbishment.
Noise Levels - Facing the elevated road the noise doesnt penetrate into the room. It was quite and comfortable.
Food - The breakfast was very average. Itc grand maratha is the mecca for f&b experiences in Mumbai but the breakfast didnt impress.On the contrary the food at Yi Jing was phenomenal, one of my favorite chinese restaurants in Mumbai.

SHOUT OUT - Yuvna did a fabulous job, she was in touch with us continuously during our stay and made us feel at home.

Overall - The hotel provides good price to service value, not the fanciest but justifies the price it commands.

#itcmaratha #mumbaihotels

Мы приехали сюда на шахматный турнир — я сопровождал пятерых детей. Мы сами из Узбекистана, из Центральной Азии. До приезда переживали прежде всего из-за безопасности, питания и того, насколько комфортно здесь будет детям. В итоге все опасения оказались напрасными.

Номера отличные, просторные и комфортные. Всё необходимое есть, уборку проводили каждый день. Безопасность организована на хорошем уровне, а персонал очень внимательный, доброжелательный и терпеливый. Дети иногда капризничали или просили привычную для них еду, но сотрудники всегда относились к этому с пониманием и старались помочь. Причём помогали искренне, не ожидая чаевых.

Питание организовано в формате шведского стола три раза в день: на завтрак, обед и ужин. Выбор блюд большой, а любителям индийской и экзотической кухни здесь особенно понравится. При необходимости для наших детей могли отдельно приготовить что-нибудь более привычное.

Отдельная благодарность менеджеру Виджею! Он очень помогал нам с питанием, всегда был внимателен к просьбам и старался найти решение. Руководству гостиницы обязательно стоит отметить его прекрасную работу — Виджей действительно заслуживает премии!

Спасибо всей команде гостиницы за гостеприимство и прекрасное отношение к детям. Всем друзьям из Узбекистана и других стран Центральной Азии смело рекомендую эту гостиницу. Мы остались очень довольны!

I stayed at ITC Maratha about a year ago and had a wonderful experience. I was generously upgraded to a beautiful two-room suite, which was exceptionally spacious, elegant and comfortable. The large bathroom was impressive, and the shower was particularly enjoyable. A few of the bathroom fixtures could benefit from an upgrade, but this did not detract significantly from the overall beauty and comfort of the suite.

Breakfast was excellent, with an extensive selection of delicious options to suit different preferences. The hotel also had an amazing choice of restaurants for dining, and the food I tried was exceptional.

I also visited the spa and had a massage, which was incredibly relaxing and one of the highlights of my stay. Overall, the magnificent suite, excellent dining, wonderful breakfast and relaxing spa experience made my stay at ITC Maratha memorable and thoroughly enjoyable.

reviews.text: This is my second stay at ITC Maratha with my family. We are going to keep coming back. The location, cleanliness, family friendly staff and amenities all line up. The most important is the staff here. On my way to the hotel, recently, I left my passport at the airport and only realized it on arrival during check-in. The staff calmed our anxiety, checked us in and then Vijay P and his colleague Akash connected with airport staff to retrace my steps and locate my passport. I could not give the people and the place a higher rating. If I could, I would. I recommend this place to all my colleagues planning a visit to Mumbai. High praise for Vijay and Akash. It is such things that matter. Love ITC Maratha and the staff here.

Went for lunch here after a business meeting and had one of the best meals at Yi Jing.

A special thank you to Chef Liang Xiao Qing for the wonderful recommendations, every dish was absolutely delicious.

Without a doubt, this is one of the most authentic Chinese dining experiences I’ve had in Mumbai so far.

If you visit, don’t miss the chicken dim sum and the hand-pulled noodles. They were easily the highlights of the meal.

The service was exceptional from start to finish warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming.

Thank you to the entire team for making our afternoon so special. We can’t wait to be back. ❤️

A special mention to Glady, one of the lovely hostesses at the hotel. While we were waiting in the lobby to meet our Governor of Nagaland.. she noticed that we were unsure of where to go and immediately came over to assist us. She arranged a comfortable place for us to sit, guided us through everything, and made us feel genuinely welcomed.

I work in the hospitality industry myself, so I truly appreciate thoughtful service when I experience it. Her warmth, attentiveness, and beautiful smile really stood out.

Thank you, Glady, for making our wait so pleasant. Keep up the wonderful work, and thank you to the entire team at IDC Hotel for having such a wonderful host. ❤️

I’ve stayed at several Taj properties and have always associated the brand with warm, intuitive hospitality, which is why my experience at Taj Santacruz was disappointing.

I had two consecutive reservations and was specifically asked at check-in to return to reception the following day simply to revalidate my room key. When I did exactly that, I was unexpectedly asked to produce my ID again to verify my identity. While I understand that hotels have security protocols, the entire interaction felt unnecessarily cumbersome and was handled without the warmth or ease I would expect from a five-star Taj property.

What was even more disappointing was when I asked to speak with a manager whom I had previously seen approaching guests at breakfast and inviting them to reach out if they needed anything. While a staff member was calling him, I could hear him asking, “Who’s calling me? What do they want?” The tone came across as irritated rather than welcoming, which was particularly unpleasant when I was simply asking for assistance.

He did eventually come over, explain that the ID requirement was protocol and apologise, which I appreciate. However, hospitality is not only about following procedures: it is also about how guests are made to feel while those procedures are carried out. Unfortunately, the overall experience felt transactional and lacking in the genuine warmth I have experienced at other Taj hotels.

From the moment of arrival, this stay distinguished itself as an exceptional experience, truly one of the best. The welcome itself was a delightful introduction to the thoughtful hospitality awaiting, marked by the traditional gesture of a fresh tulsi har, its fragrant leaves offering a sense of calm and well-being. This was immediately followed by a refreshing welcome drink, a perfect antidote to any travel weariness, served with a genuine smile that made one feel instantly at home.
The check-in process, often a point of friction at other establishments, was remarkably swift and effortless. It was handled with such efficiency and grace that it felt almost instantaneous, allowing for a seamless transition from the journey to the comfort of the hotel. There was no tedious waiting or complicated paperwork; instead, it was a smooth, professional transaction that underscored the establishment's commitment to guest satisfaction.
Following the expedited check-in, I was personally escorted to my assigned room. The path led through immaculately kept corridors, hinting at the attention to detail prevalent throughout the property. Upon entering, the room immediately impressed with its generous proportions and pristine condition. It was a spacious sanctuary, thoughtfully arranged to maximize comfort and convenience, with ample room to move and relax. The decor was elegant yet understated, creating an atmosphere of sophisticated tranquility. Every surface gleamed, and the air was fresh and inviting, clearly indicating meticulous preparation.
Adjacent to the main sleeping area, the washroom mirrored the room's high standards. It was spotlessly clean, a true testament to the rigorous hygiene protocols in place. The fixtures were modern and well-maintained, and there was a generous supply of fresh, plush towels. The overall impression was one of impeccable cleanliness and comfort, making it a truly pleasant space.
Throughout my entire stay, the service was consistently top-notch. Every interaction with the staff, from the front desk to housekeeping and dining, was characterized by genuine warmth, attentiveness, and a proactive desire to assist. Requests were met with prompt efficiency, and there was an evident pride in their work that elevated every aspect of the guest experience. It truly felt as though every individual on the team was dedicated to ensuring a memorable and enjoyable visit.
A particular highlight was the breakfast. It was an amazing, truly tasty spread that catered to every palate and preference. The variety was extensive, featuring a delectable array of both local and international dishes, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Each item was a culinary delight, bursting with flavor and presented beautifully. The aroma alone was enough to entice, and the taste more than delivered on that promise, making for a truly satisfying start to each day. I simply loved every aspect of it, from the vibrant presentation to the exquisite flavors. This entire experience, from the moment of welcome to the final farewell, was nothing short of luxurious, leaving an indelible impression of comfort, elegance, and unparalleled hospitality.

My family and I chose The Taj for a staycation to celebrate a birthday, and it turned out to be a truly luxurious and unforgettable experience!
We had a stunning runway view room and my whole family absolutely loved it. The rooms are super luxurious and exceeded all our expectations — impeccably clean, with hygiene maintained at the highest level, and every corner had a delightful surprise waiting for us.
The food was absolutely delicious. For lunch, we ordered in-room dining — Chicken Biryani, Sandwich, Dal Khichdi, Pizza and Potato Wedges — and every single dish was full of amazing flavour.
We had our dinner and breakfast buffet at Tiqri and it was the best spread with a wide variety of choices, made even more special with wonderful live music.
I would highly recommend everyone to experience this at least once in a lifetime. It was truly a fantastic stay!

reviews.text: A delicious throwback to Bombay’s golden era, this vintage-inspired brunch at Pondichéry Café was all about indulgence and nostalgia. The live chaat counter brought the unmistakable energy of Bombay streets, with every bite bursting with flavour. A standout was the Eggs Kejriwal—comforting, cheesy and wonderfully indulgent—while the crispy tempura added a playful contemporary touch to the spread. From familiar Bombay favourites to elegant global bites, the brunch balanced old-school charm with modern flair. With lively counters, beautiful flavours and a relaxed atmosphere, it felt like a celebration of Bombay—nostalgic, vibrant and deliciously unforgettable.

reviews.text:
My first time at a Mumbai five-star, and Sofitel BKC made it unforgettable. ✨

I came for an Amazon conference, but from the very first moment this hotel felt like an experience in itself. Right at the entrance, the Sardar ji doorman welcomed us with such warmth and politeness — that one graceful gesture set the tone for everything that followed.

**The Welcome & The People**

Step inside and you're greeted by young hotel-management graduates — professional, impeccably and beautifully dressed, every interaction polished yet genuinely warm. There's a quiet confidence to how the whole team carries itself; you feel looked after without ever feeling fussed over. This is hospitality done with real pride.

**The Service**

Fabulous — there's really no other word. The staff were supportive, prompt and polite at every single turn, always a step ahead of what you needed. And what impressed me most: the service never dipped for a moment, even up in the second-floor auditorium where the conference was held. The same attentiveness, the same grace, whether in the grand lobby or mid-session upstairs. That consistency is the true mark of a five-star.

**The Interiors**

Simply stunning. Everything is so tastefully and thoughtfully done — elegant, luxurious, with that unmistakable five-star finish in every corner. You find yourself slowing down just to take it all in. (Do check the photos and videos I've attached — they speak for themselves.)

**The Experience**

Attending the conference here was a pleasure from start to finish. Smooth, seamless, and wrapped in that lovely Sofitel graciousness throughout. For a first taste of a Mumbai five-star, it truly could not have been better.

**Final verdict**

A brilliant, lovely experience end to end — gracious people, fabulous service right up to the auditorium, gorgeous interiors, flawless hospitality. Sofitel BKC, you've set the bar high. I'll happily be back. 💛

reviews.text:
Our recent stay at this 5-star hotel was truly exceptional, with outstanding service and genuine hospitality from the moment we arrived until our departure.

Every aspect of our stay was handled with remarkable care—from the warm and efficient check-in to impeccable daily housekeeping, wonderful breakfasts, and the half-board dinner experience. The dinner buffet offered an impressive variety of beautifully presented dishes, with the chefs consistently delivering excellent quality and flavor.

A special thank-you goes to the entire restaurant team—hosts, servers, and chefs—for making every meal such a memorable experience. Pondicherry cafe manager Johnny who was always gracious and attentive , Dhurmil, & Tejas,  also deserve particular recognition for their warm, attentive, and personalized service. They took the time to understand our food preferences, anticipate our needs, and make us feel genuinely welcomed and valued throughout our stay. Their attention to detail truly elevated the dining experience.

We would also like to acknowledge the wonderful front desk team, especially Manasvi and Pradnya, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. We were particularly touched by the thoughtful presentation of a personalized memento by Manasvi that was tailored to something casually mentioned, by my wife, in a conversation. That small but incredibly meaningful gesture demonstrated the kind of attentiveness and personalization that distinguishes exceptional hospitality.

A heartfelt thank-you as well to Kunika, the Front Office Manager, for being so approachable and helpful throughout our stay. She took the time to answer our questions, address our requests, and efficiently facilitate a room change when we requested one. Her professionalism and willingness to assist made a real difference.

We are grateful to all the hosts, servers, chefs, housekeeping staff, and front office colleagues who contributed to such a memorable experience. It was the combination of exceptional food, attentive service, thoughtful personalization, and genuine warmth that made this stay truly deserving of its 5-star reputation.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this property and would be be delighted to return. A sincere thank-you to the entire team for making us feel not just like guests, but truly valued and cared for.

Terrible Billing Practices and Zero Accountability – Avoid This Property

Our experience with the JW Marriott Mumbai Sahar has been utterly disappointing. We booked two fully refundable rooms and canceled well in advance of the deadline, receiving an official cancellation confirmation clearly stating a $0 / zero balance due.

Despite this, the hotel wrongfully charged our account for one night for both rooms. It has now been two months of chasing them for our money ($400) back. While Reservation Executive Komal Waghela admitted the charge was a mistake and agreed in writing via email to process the refund, absolutely nothing has happened. Empty promises, endless delays, and zero follow-through.

It is completely unacceptable for a luxury property of this caliber to hold guests' money hostage through unauthorized charges and incompetent billing resolution. If you book here, keep a very close eye on your credit card statements. Until our refund is finally processed and credited, I cannot recommend staying at this hotel.

I recently completed another stay at this hotel and, overall, had a very enjoyable experience. Several of my colleagues were also staying at the property during this visit, and we all had positive experiences.

The rooms are comfortable, the beds are excellent, and having a bathtub made the stay especially relaxing. One feature I particularly appreciated was being able to connect my Amazon Fire Stick to the television, which helped make the room feel more like home. The hotel is also extremely convenient to the airport, making it a great choice for business travelers.

There were many highlights throughout my stay. The check-in process was seamless and professional, the Executive Lounge staff were exceptionally warm, attentive, and welcoming, housekeeping provided excellent service, and the breakfast offerings were delicious and well prepared with plenty of variety. These strengths combined to make for a comfortable and memorable stay.

As a Lifetime Titanium Elite member, I was somewhat disappointed not to receive a room upgrade. In comparison to my experiences at properties such as The St. Regis Mumbai, The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake, and JW Marriott Mumbai Juhu, upgrades seem to be less frequent here. During my stays, I have typically only received an Executive Club level upgrade rather than a suite upgrade, despite my loyalty status and use of the Marriott Bonvoy app for check-in.

I would also suggest some enhancements to the Executive Lounge food offerings. While the service from the lounge team is outstanding, the food selection feels somewhat basic compared to other premium Marriott properties. A more efficient live-cooking station and a broader selection of Western dishes would further elevate what is already a very good lounge experience.

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and greatly appreciate the hospitality extended by the entire team. This is a well-managed property with comfortable accommodations, excellent service, and a convenient location. With a few small improvements, particularly around elite member recognition and lounge dining options, it could deliver an even more exceptional guest experience.

An Absolutely Memorable Stay at JW Marriott Mumbai Sahar

We had a wonderful stay at JW Marriott Mumbai Sahar with our family, and it became even more special because the hotel went above and beyond to celebrate my brother’s birthday. ❤️

A very special thank you to Saloni for her thoughtful efforts in decorating our room so beautifully and arranging such a delicious cake. The decoration was absolutely stunning, and my brother was genuinely amazed by the surprise! 😍 I truly appreciate the time, care, and personal touch she put into making his birthday so memorable.

We also absolutely loved the food, especially at Barqat Restaurant. The hospitality there was exceptional, and the team made my brother’s birthday even more special by celebrating with us and arranging a beautiful birthday cake. 🎂❤️ It was such a thoughtful gesture and made the evening truly memorable.

We really appreciated all their recommendations, and every dish we tried was incredible by Chef Faheem Qureshi and their team especially Nisha. The Galouti Kebab was definitely one of our favorites! Honestly, every dish was mind-blowing, and we loved the experience so much that we ended up visiting Barqat twice during our stay. 🤩

Overall, it was an amazing family experience. From the beautiful ambience and delicious food to the warm, friendly, and incredibly helpful staff, everything was wonderful.

Thank you to the entire JW Marriott Mumbai Sahar team, especially Saloni and the Barqat team, for such exceptional hospitality and for making my brother’s birthday so special and memorable! ❤️✨

Extremely disappointing stay—poor maintenance and unacceptable service
​I stayed at JW Marriott Mumbai from the 5th to the 9th, and the experience fell drastically short of 5-star luxury standards.
​Faulty Room Maintenance & Hygiene Issue: The bathroom door does not close properly (video recorded and attached). In a shared room, a non-closing bathroom door is not just an inconvenience—it raises serious health and hygiene concerns.
​Inconsistent Housekeeping: On day one, the room was stocked with 3 bath towels, 2 face towels, and 2 pairs of slippers. On day third , despite turning on the "Clean My Room" light, housekeeping randomly reduced our supplies to 2 bath towels, 1 face towel, and only 1 pair of slippers.
​Abysmal In-Room Service: We ordered food via Swiggy and called reception requesting basic cutlery—2 plates and 2 spoons. We had to call three separate times and waited over 1 hour and 30 minutes just to receive two plates and spoons.
​Basic room functionality, consistent amenities, and timely basic service are fundamental expectations at a luxury hotel. JW Marriott failed on all three counts during this stay. Very poor attention to detail and zero sense of urgency for guest comfort.

My stay at Fairmont Mumbai was truly exceptional and exceeded my expectations in every way. The hotel’s architecture is magnificent, and the breathtaking lobby creates an unforgettable first impression. The ambience throughout the property is stunning, sophisticated and welcoming.

My room was exceptionally spacious, with beautiful views and an intelligent, thoughtfully designed layout. The technology was innovative yet extremely user-friendly, from the smart curtains that opened and closed automatically to the well-integrated room controls. I especially loved the separate, generously sized closet with its cleverly designed storage, as well as the minibar beautifully incorporated into an elegant wardrobe. The rain shower was wonderful, and the luxurious hair and skincare products were another thoughtful touch.

Every staff member I encountered was courteous, friendly and genuinely hospitable. The consistently warm and attentive service made the experience feel even more special.

Breakfast was outstanding, with an enormous selection of options. Almost everything one could imagine seemed to have its own station, and the food was exceptional in both variety and quality.

The only drawback was some confusion on the surrounding roads due to the hotel’s proximity to the airport. If you miss the correct turn, you may accidentally enter the airport parking area and have to pay a fee to exit, so it is worth following the directions carefully.

Aside from that minor inconvenience, I absolutely loved my stay. The remarkable architecture, beautiful room, innovative technology, exceptional food and wonderful staff made Fairmont Mumbai my new favourite hotel. I would love to stay here again.

The Great Gatsby of Mumbai

The moment you step in, you are transported straight into Gatsby's world. The grandeur, the bling, and a 30+ft entrance lobby that makes you stop and look up before you have even reached the reception desk. The owners' taste shows in every detail, and they have clearly spared no expense in building something this magnificent. It is pure theatre, and it works.

The standout for me was the longevity spa. It has machines I have not seen anywhere else in the country, and the staff are trained, professional and genuinely know what they are doing rather than working off a script. The massage therapists have magical hands. You can feel the craft within the first two minutes, in the kind of pressure and pacing that only comes from real training.

The rooms are enormous, closer to suites than standard rooms. I was fortunate to stay on Fairmont Gold, and my room looked directly out at flights taking off and landing, which I could happily watch for an hour at a time. Comfortable beds, generous proportions, and a layout that would easily suit a family.

The one real let-down was the South Indian food. I struggled to get a basic dosa done right across my entire stay, which is a strange gap in a Mumbai hotel operating at this level. When everything else is this considered, the simplest thing on the menu should not be the hardest to get right.

Verdict: A spectacular property with a spa genuinely worth travelling for.

My recent two-night stay at Fairmont Mumbai was a truly wonderful experience.

I was staying at the hotel while attending the Longevity Summit as the official Longevity Ambassador, and the hotel made the entire experience even more special. ### A beautiful hotel let down by a poor arrival experience

I recently stayed at Fairmont Mumbai and came away with mixed feelings. The hotel itself is impressive — beautifully designed, spacious rooms, excellent in-room facilities and outstanding housekeeping. The F&B team was also a highlight, with courteous servers and the small, personal interactions that make guests feel genuinely welcomed.

Unfortunately, the arrival experience was far below the standard expected from a luxury property.

I arrived around 11:15 pm after a long journey for a summit, with details of both travellers already provided and confirmation received. I waited 5–10 minutes for luggage assistance and then another 15 minutes while the Front Office tried to locate my reservation. Despite showing the QR code provided by the organisers, there was considerable confusion, little communication and no sense of ownership.

It eventually became clear that although the organisers had provided the guest list, the individual reservation had not been properly created in the hotel's system. Even after the second traveller's name was located, it took additional time to arrange the room. An 11:15 pm arrival eventually resulted in a room only after almost an hour.

What was particularly disappointing was the absence of basic hospitality during the wait. No water was offered. Only after around 45 minutes did the Duty Manager ask whether I would like some. For a tired guest arriving late at night, this should ideally have been an automatic courtesy.

I understand that hotels can be busy, sold out, or face booking issues. The concern is how such situations are handled. A luxury hotel should be able to manage an unexpected problem with proactive communication, empathy, ownership and service recovery.

There was also a serious concern with breakfast. I had eggs, cereals, fruits and nuts before checkout and subsequently experienced what appeared to be food poisoning. I cannot establish the cause, but some nuts tasted noticeably rancid and the cereals did not seem particularly fresh. I therefore believe the hotel's food freshness and safety controls would benefit from review.

To be fair, this is not a criticism of the entire hotel. The rooms, interiors, facilities, housekeeping and several F&B team members were excellent.

For a hotel of this stature, luxury hospitality is ultimately tested when something goes wrong. Unfortunately, the arrival experience and subsequent food-related illness significantly affected my overall impression.

I had considered Fairmont Mumbai for a future family stay, but after this experience, I would unfortunately think twice.

**Overall: an excellent property with very good rooms, housekeeping and F&B service, but a disappointing Front Office arrival and service-recovery experience, along with a concerning breakfast-related illness.**

Airport Convenience Meets Genuine Luxury - With One Catch

Fairmont Mumbai is a genuinely impressive property, and it shows from the location onward. It sits right at Terminal 2 of Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, and the hotel itself leans into a striking 1920s Art Deco theme — grand, theatrical, and consistent throughout the public spaces. Amenities are strong: a rooftop infinity pool, a genuinely impressive wellness spa (Blu Xone, with longevity-focused treatments like cryotherapy), a solid fitness centre, and a dining line-up that punches well above typical airport-hotel standard — The Merchants food hall with its live kitchens was a highlight, alongside an elegant tea lounge and a stylish bar. The room itself was comfortable and well-appointed, with a polished, considered feel that matched the rest of the property. Service throughout was professional and well-styled — the kind of consistent polish you'd expect at this tier.

The standout, though, was the Fairmont Gold executive lounge — a true luxury experience. All-day refreshments, a strong breakfast spread, and evening canapés and cocktails, all in a private, elevated setting well removed from the general hotel buzz. Watching aircraft on the runway from the lounge over a coffee was a genuinely memorable touch. The staff running the lounge were attentive and warm throughout the stay, and made the experience feel properly premium rather than just another perk.

One honest note: the immediate surroundings looked a bit dodgy — not what you'd expect stepping out of a hotel at this level. That said, being this close to the airport is a real convenience — it lets you beat Mumbai traffic entirely and skip the usual stress of getting to or from the airport.

We booked a suite at Fairmont Mumbai expecting a comfortable and relaxing stay, but unfortunately the experience was very disappointing.

The exhaust in the master bedroom bathroom Toliter was not working. We repeatedly raised the issue, and while several staff members came to the room to ask questions and understand the complaint, nobody actually resolved it. it was a torture to stay in the room without toilet exchust fan working!

We were eventually offered another room, but that room had an unpleasant smell. We had also clearly informed the hotel about our dust mite allergy, yet the replacement room did not appear to have been properly deep cleaned.

Another major concern was the extremely slow response time. Whether it was housekeeping, food delivery, or other services, requests often took hours. What was particularly frustrating was having multiple staff members come to our room to discuss or ask questions about our complaints, while the actual problems remained unresolved. This repeatedly interrupted our vacation and caused considerable inconvenience.

Accessibility was also a concern. My mother and sister had difficulty walking, and we found the hotel did not provide sufficiently convenient wheelchair/handicap-friendly access for their needs.

Overall, the biggest disappointment was not simply that problems occurred, but that there seemed to be a lot of discussion and follow-up questions without effective ownership or timely resolution. We expected much better from Fairmont, especially after booking a suite.

An Excellent Stay at Fairmont Mumbai – Exceptional Service
We are currently staying at Fairmont Mumbai and, having already spent five nights here with another two nights still to go, I felt it was important to share our experience while we are still enjoying our stay.
For the past 15 years, we have been regular guests at the JW Marriott, staying there twice a year. We have always valued the personal service and the relationships we built with the staff over the years. However, with many of the familiar faces having moved on, we felt that the experience was no longer quite the same.
We first tried Fairmont Mumbai when it opened, and this is now our third visit. While it took us a little time to warm up to the hotel, I have to say that this visit has really changed our perception. We have been extremely pleased with the service and, in particular, with the quality and attitude of the staff. It feels as though the initial teething issues have long been overcome, and the team has developed into a very professional, attentive and genuinely caring group.
One of the things that has impressed us most this time is the personalised service. It reminded us of what we used to appreciate so much about the JW Marriott, and it is wonderful to find that same level of care here.
I would particularly like to recognise a few members of the team who have made our stay special.
At the restaurant, Ankit, the manager, deserves a special mention. I take chia seeds for medicinal purposes, and when I mentioned this, Ankit went far beyond what one would normally expect to help arrange them for me. He was extremely helpful, attentive and genuinely concerned about making sure I had what I needed. It was a small detail, but it demonstrated the kind of thoughtful service that makes a stay memorable.
I would also like to thank Kedarnath at the restaurant, who has been very helpful and attentive throughout our stay. Manali has also been absolutely lovely and has been consistently warm, helpful and attentive.
A special mention must also go to Yogesh, the pastry chef, who has been so lovely and extremely helpful. His kindness and willingness to assist have really added to our experience, and it is these personal touches that make guests feel genuinely looked after.
At the lobby and reception, Anouska has also been wonderful, and Dinesh from the Concierge team has been extremely helpful and professional.
It is often the people who make a hotel experience, and on this visit, the people at Fairmont Mumbai have genuinely impressed us. Their warmth, attentiveness and willingness to go the extra mile have made us feel very welcome.
We still have another two nights of our stay, so hopefully there is more to come, but based on our experience so far, we are very happy that we decided to give Fairmont Mumbai another try.
After many years of being loyal JW Marriott guests, I can honestly say that Fairmont Mumbai has now won us over. We are very pleased with the service and the team, and we look forward to returning and continuing to see the hotel develop.
A sincere thank you to the entire Fairmont Mumbai team for making our stay such a pleasant one.

We stayed at the Fairmont for two nights and had an excellent experience overall. The hotel is beautifully maintained, conveniently located with easy access to the airport, and all the staff were exceptionally friendly, attentive and professional. Full credit to the entire hotel team for their hospitality.

We tried a wide selection of dishes during our stay, and almost everything was very good, as reflected in the photos. However, the one major disappointment was the thalis. We tried both the vegetarian and non-vegetarian thalis, and unfortunately, neither matched the quality or standards of the rest of the restaurant. They felt surprisingly substandard and simply did not belong on the menu of a hotel of this calibre.

I specifically shared this feedback with the restaurant and kitchen teams, as I genuinely feel these two items should either be significantly improved or removed from the menu.

Apart from the thalis, everything else—from the accommodation and location to the food, service and staff—was excellent. We had a very pleasant stay and would happily recommend the hotel, but I would personally advise avoiding the thalis unless they are improved.

05 August 2026 :
Dear Rajiv,
I hear a lot of apologies & regret. I am sorry too but I want to know what corrective action has been taken if any. Sorry is a just a beautiful word, how does it bring about a change I would like to know. I want to know why this happened at every step. From booking my spa appointment before even came to stay till we walked out of the property!! WHY??
Purnima Lakhiani.

01 August 2026
I visited Fairmont Spa, Sahar, Andheri, on 1 August 2026 for their Red Light Therapy treatment, which is marketed as one of their premium treatments. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst spa experiences I have ever had.
During the treatment, my face became intensely red to the point that I genuinely feared it had been burned. Instead of reassuring me or taking immediate corrective action, the staff's response was shocking. When I asked for ice to cool my face, I was told they didn't have any. It is unbelievable that a luxury hotel spa cannot provide something as basic as ice during a skin emergency.
I then requested some face cream to soothe my skin. Rather than helping, I was told, "Why don't you buy one? The spa is just nearby." Imagine suggesting that a customer with an inflamed face should go shopping instead of receiving immediate aftercare. Only after insisting was I reluctantly given some cream.
What disturbed me even more was the complete lack of concern shown by the staff. There was no apology, no attempt to assess my condition, no follow-up, and no sense of responsibility. The priority seemed to be collecting payment immediately rather than ensuring that a customer who had just walked out of a facial treatment with a bright red face was actually okay.
The treatment also ran unnecessarily late into the night, making the entire experience feel disorganized and highly unprofessional.
For a property carrying the Fairmont name, I expected trained therapists, proper protocols, and basic customer care. Instead, I experienced poor handling of what could have become a serious skin issue, dismissive service, and a complete lack of professionalism.
I would strongly advise anyone considering Red Light Therapy here to think twice. Luxury is not just about beautiful interiors—it is about competence, safety, and how you treat your guests when something goes wrong. On all three counts, this experience was deeply disappointing.

I visited the hotel for a lunch with a colleague/friend. The lobby is large and impressive with the art deco - this contrasted with the strange zig zag and twisting and slopping ramp to entrance of the hotel. Weird! Like an amusement park ride.

One is wowed immediately upon entry. Oooohhh
It feels like the Great Gatsby! Opulent and lavish. But sadly filled with unrequited love, fake Americanized Indian Dream, and deep loneliness.

Anyhow... i digress. Forgive me... As I sat in the lobby waiting, a child happened to be crying in the lobby area... A perfectly normal human happening that is to be expected. But his sound reverberated through the whole lobby and it dawned upon me that the designers may have gone for show and tell, and failed to consider a desirable human experience of rest, ease, beauty and calmness that is created by good management of sound. More so when reaching the hotel from the highway seems like a feat akin to surviving a ride in an unexpected amusement park next to the airport.

We sat in the Madeline for lunch; t'was early. There was not a single other guest and the beauty and expansiveness, the design and taste, altogether hit me again with its gorgeous art deco. Yet, my eyes kept veering to this towering large elecronic screen with stunning visuals... Alll very beautifully curated, yet again - the use of AI transformed the experience into one of a niggling irritant that simply wouldn't leave me alone... Like a small stone in fancy shoes. Who cares? They hurt no matter what!

--- I ask ---
Why? Oh why? Do we do this?
Think I am far too old fashioned and sensitive, peculiar and weird, to be able to appreciate and comment in this manner. My apologies...

I will end, nevertheless, and share with you the chill left in my bones even 8 hours later. The kind that cuts, and penetrates and leaves you cold and dark, feeling alone and lonely. Thankfully, the warmth of the conversation and the tasty Indian food somewhat helped to alleviate the angst of the contrasting experiences.

Great looking hotel! But it didn't feel so great. Do something please. Let this not be the Great Gatsby! Beneath its glittering presentation of Jazz Age, it was a story built on profound loneliness, unrequited longing, and the failure of dreams.

The 1 star is only because the platform requires a rating to post the review.

I genuinely don't understand how this is considered a 5-star hotel.

The rooms are old and badly outdated, and the bathroom is no better. The curtain rods were rusted, and there is no separate shower area—you have to shower standing in the bathtub. The bathtub floor is uneven and becomes extremely slippery when wet, making getting in and out genuinely risky.

I requested a room with a proper separate shower, but was told that there were no rooms available with one.

The policy of not allowing outside food in guest rooms was another major disappointment. I've stayed at several other 5-star hotels in Mumbai, including Westin, Hilton and Radisson, and this is the first time I've encountered such a restriction.

For a hotel carrying a 5-star tag, the condition of the rooms, bathroom design and restrictive policies are simply not what I expect. Very disappointing stay.

Stayed 5 nights at Novotel Mumbai International Airport while I was in the city to deliver a BNI training, and it turned out to be one of the easiest stays I have had in Mumbai.

The room was spacious and smelled fresh every single day. The soundproofing genuinely surprised me. There is a metro station right in front of the hotel and I did not hear a thing. Slept well all five nights, which is rare for me when I am travelling and working at the same time.

Breakfast buffet is wide and covers every cuisine. What made me happy was the South Indian counter, idly, upma and dosa done properly.

The small things are where they win: complimentary airport drop, laundry, and welcome snacks and fruits waiting in the room with a personal note that had my name printed on it. That note made my day.

The banquet hall worked well for our training. Air conditioning was comfortable and the food served through the sessions was good.

Special mention to Nandita at the front desk. Warm, quick, and genuinely helpful. Honestly the whole team was like that. Even the aroma in the lounge is something you carry with you.

Solid value for what you pay. I will be staying here again.

We had a truly wonderful experience during our stay, and I would especially like to appreciate the amazing hospitality and care shown by the entire team.

The buffet breakfast experience was made extra special thanks to Manish, who was constantly on his toes ensuring my husband got his dosas and coffee just the way he liked them. His attentiveness and prompt service were truly appreciated.

A special thank you to Saurav, who helped us arrange boiled water for Eli's formula milk. Anyone travelling with a baby knows how difficult it can be to manage such little but essential things when away from home, and his help meant a lot to us.

Ansh was wonderful with Eli and happily provided pancakes for her. He also thoughtfully recommended the chia pudding, which had no added sugar and was suitable for the baby. Such thoughtful recommendations really made a difference!

We would also like to thank Sonali, Rohit, Disha, Hommy, and Joel, who were always attentive and prompt in providing tissues, cutlery, and anything else we needed during our meals.

Our experience started beautifully at check-in with Ravi, who gave Eli a lovely camel soft toy. She absolutely loved it and carried it happily throughout our stay! Check-out was equally smooth, thanks to Rameez, Priyanka, and Tanuja, who made the process seamless. To Eli's delight, she was also gifted a lion soft toy by the three of them—a gesture that made her incredibly happy.

It's these small acts of kindness and genuine warmth that make a hotel stay truly memorable, especially when travelling with a little one. Thank you to the entire team for making us feel so comfortable and cared for. Eli definitely had a wonderful time, and so did we! ❤️

Small Suggestion.
Please fix the last ledge of the adult pool ladder as it is broken and can be a safety hazard to other guests

We recently enjoyed a wonderful staycation at Fairfield Mumbai and booked a Queen Garden View Room especially for our son, who absolutely loves planes and aviation. ✈️❤️

The runway view from the hotel is simply awesome and made the stay even more special for him. The staff were very helpful and welcoming, the food was lovely, and we especially enjoyed the terrace swimming pool, where our son had a fantastic time.

Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend Fairfield Mumbai for a family staycation—especially for families with kids who love aviation and watching planes! ✈️🛫

One suggestion for the Fairfield team:
It would be really helpful if guests could book over a phone call with complete information about the room options, especially the runway-view rooms, rather than having to rely mainly on email communication. Also, I strongly recommend highlighting and advertising the RUNWAY VIEW more prominently, as it is a fantastic feature and can be a major attraction for aviation-loving families.

Thank you, Fairfield Mumbai, for a lovely staycation! ❤️✈️

reviews.text:
Great location and food, but compromised facilities and poor maintenance
Sun-n-Sand has a lot going for it, but key issues with maintenance and guest amenities significantly held back the experience.
The direct sea location is fantastic and provides great views. The rooms were comfortable, and the breakfast spread was high quality and delicious.
Historically, the pool area was one of the absolute highlights of the property. The addition/presence of Bastian has unfortunately taken over and compromised the relaxed pool vibe, making it far less enjoyable for hotel guests looking to swim or unwind. Ongoing renovations resulted in the dormitory ceiling leaking. Ongoing maintenance is understandable, but water leakage in guest quarters due to construction is completely unacceptable.
If you are coming strictly for the beach views, dining, and comfortable room accommodations, it is a solid choice. However, if you are looking forward to enjoying the pool area or staying in the dormitory section during renovations, manage your expectations accordingly.

We stayed at Meluha The Fern, Powai for one week with our family, and we had a truly wonderful experience.

Mumbai was completely new to us, as we are from Australia. Our children have grown up in Australia and were not very familiar with the Indian system, culture, or way of doing things. From the moment we arrived, Mr. Monty Chabra, the Manager, made us feel extremely comfortable and well looked after.

Monty ji provided us with exceptional hospitality and personal attention throughout our stay. He took extra care of our children, made sure they were comfortable, and patiently guided us whenever we needed help. He also helped us with local information, places to visit, transportation, and many other things that made our stay in Mumbai much easier.

What impressed us most was that his hospitality went beyond his professional responsibilities. His warmth, kindness and willingness to help made us feel as though we had a family member looking after us in Mumbai.

The food at the hotel was amazing, with a great variety and excellent taste. We also found the floor staff very courteous, attentive and helpful. Their service added to the overall pleasant experience during our stay.

A special thank you to Monty ji for going the extra mile and making our first experience in Mumbai so memorable. We truly appreciate everything he did for our family.

We would also like to thank the entire team at Meluha The Fern, Powai for their excellent service, delicious food and warm hospitality.

Highly recommended! We would definitely stay here again whenever we visit Mumbai.

Exceptional Hospitality and Genuine Care at T24 Retro, Mumbai
My husband and I recently stayed at T24 Retro and our experience was truly exceptional.
From the moment we arrived, we were met with warmth, professionalism, and genuine concern. What stood out most, however, was the extraordinary empathy and personal care shown by the entire team.
My husband was unwell when we arrived, and the staff went far beyond what we could have expected to make him comfortable. The chefs took the time to understand his needs and thoughtfully prepared customized meals for him throughout our stay — breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Every small gesture made a difficult situation so much easier for us.
Special thanks to the managers, chefs, servers,  housekeeping, security and reception desk for their patience, kindness, and attentiveness. Their care felt genuinely personal and heartfelt.
If you are visiting Mumbai and looking for a hotel that combines comfort, quality, and truly heartfelt hospitality, I would wholeheartedly recommend T24 Retro.
A sincere and special thank you to the owner of this hotel, whose thoughtful leadership and personal touch were reflected in every aspect of our stay. Your kindness meant more than you know.

reviews.text:
Our stay at Kohinoor Continental genuinely felt like a 5-star experience, especially considering the overall service and the way our luggage was handled right from check-in to the room. The check-in process was smooth and easy, and the staff made the entire arrival experience feel very comfortable and well-managed.

The room layout was excellent, the TV was quite large, and the overall ambience of the hotel was amazing. However, the TV isn’t a Smart TV, which unfortunately makes it almost useless for entertainment beyond basic channels. If you’re planning to relax with a movie or series on OTT after a long day, it definitely takes away from the experience and spoils the entertainment mood.

The food is definitely on the expensive side, but the quality is top-notch. We ordered pizza and chai one day, and the pizza was absolutely delicious—we loved it! They also served us cookies, which were really nice and a thoughtful touch.

The location is another big plus. There are plenty of restaurants nearby, and the hotel is situated on a busy, convenient street, so getting around and finding places to eat is very easy. It was also quite convenient to get to the airport from the hotel.

The only other concern I had was the Wi-Fi. I tried working using the hotel Wi-Fi, but the connection and overall performance weren’t really up to the mark.

Apart from these minor issues, it was an excellent stay with great service, amazing ambience, a convenient location, and a very smooth overall experience. Definitely felt closer to a 5-star experience than what I expected!

reviews.text:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An outstanding family buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant**

We recently enjoyed a wonderful buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant with our family, and it exceeded every expectation. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome and well taken care of. They were attentive without being intrusive, quickly helping us with seating, explaining the spread, and checking in throughout the evening to ensure everything was perfect. Their warm and professional service truly elevated the whole experience.

The buffet itself was excellent—fresh, abundant, and thoughtfully arranged. There was a great variety of starters, live counters, main courses (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options), and a tempting dessert section. Everything tasted freshly prepared, well-seasoned, and of high quality. We especially appreciated how the dishes kept coming out hot and how the counters were promptly replenished. It was easy for everyone in the family, from kids to elders, to find something they loved.

The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable, making it ideal for a relaxed family dinner. The overall value for the quality and quantity of food was outstanding. We left completely satisfied and already looking forward to our next visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious buffet experience with excellent service. Thank you to the entire team at Solitaire Restaurant for making our family evening so memorable!

We stayed here for 2 nights, and unfortunately, the experience was not quite what we expected. We booked a Deluxe Room, but it felt more like a standard room because of the limited space. When we also came the rooms smells cigarette. Even pillows. The air conditioning also wasn’t working properly during our stay.

We had quite a lot of luggage, and it would have been helpful if someone could have assisted us with a trolley. We were only accompanied up to the first floor, so we had to manage the rest of our luggage ourselves.

The receptionist was also quite straightforward and had a rather cold approach. We understand that being direct is sometimes necessary, but a little warmth and courtesy toward guests can make a big difference. Overall, there were some areas where the service and comfort could definitely be improved.

Secondly they don't have any medicine handy, which is okay but when I ordered from blinkit and requested the staffs to deliver the medicine to my room they said no, and asked me to come down to collect. When I'm visibly sick because of their own messed up rooms, and this is the hospitality they have shown.
Thirdly, pathetic, very limited, and overpriced menu. And they will not let you order food from outside.
Overall I somehow survived the bloom. Unless I want pneumonia, I will never visit again!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Fantastic First Experience – Amazing Food and Stellar Service!
"Absolutely loved my first-ever visit to Bloom! The food was incredibly delicious, but I have to give a special shoutout to the Orange Chia seeds—such a unique and refreshing treat!
What truly made my experience unforgettable, though, was the stellar service from Prosenjit. From the moment I walked in, he had a warm, welcoming smile on his face. He is incredibly kind, attentive, and actually took the time to help me decide on the perfect dish. It is rare to see such genuine hospitality!
The ambiance of the area is lovely, and the dining space is kept impeccably clean. I do have one small constructive suggestion for the management: the washroom needs a bit more attention as there were some used tissues lying around.
Overall, I am leaving with a big smile and am very happy with my visit. I am already sure I’ll be back soon. See you soon, Bloom!"

reviews.text:
I wanted to take a moment to appreciate Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash at The Mirador Hotel, Andheri.

To be very frank, my experience at the hotel was not entirely a positive one. There was an unfortunate situation which I feel happened because of some misunderstanding and maybe some lack of clarity from both sides. I dont think it would be fair to entirely blame the hotel, and neither can I say that I was completely right. Sometimes these things just happen and situations get misunderstood.

But what really stayed with me was how everything was handled afterwards.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash handled the entire situation with a lot of dignity, patience and most importantly respect. At no point I felt that they were just trying to manage me or get rid of the situation. There was a genuine sense of empathy in the way they spoke and dealt with everything, and honestly that touched me.

Its very easy to write a good review when everything goes perfectly. But I think it says much more when something actually goes wrong, and you still walk away wanting to appreciate the people involved.

For me that speaks volume about these four gentlemen and also the culture of the property.

Inspite of what happened, the way they navigated the entire situation actually changed the way I felt about the experience. I walked away without any bitterness towards the hotel. Infact, I left with respect and goodwill, and I would have no hesitation coming back to The Mirador in the future.

Sometimes you may forget what exactly went wrong, but you dont forget how someone treated you when things were not going right.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash — thank you for treating me with dignity and respect. I genuinely appreciate it and wish you guys the very best.

This is by far the worst hotel I have stayed in for many years. I could never imagine this is the standard expected from a Hilton hotel.
First of all, the room had severely outdated facilities. There was peeling paint on the walls, worn furniture and exposed rusty screws. When using the washbasin, there was an extremely strong foul drain odour. It felt like staying in a rat hole.
Secondly, the hotel system crashed during check‑in, forcing us to wait in an extremely long queue to get our room. Due to the system failure, we could not connect to the hotel Wi‑Fi. I had to pay for mobile data at my own expense, yet the hotel offered no compensation at all.
To make matters worse, the system issue remained unresolved for our entire two‑night stay. The operational efficiency was shockingly poor. The lobby was crowded with tired guests queuing every day, and staff did not even offer any drinking water for waiting guests.
On the second day of our stay, our room card stopped working. When we went to reception for help, we were told to rejoin the massive queue again, which is incomprehensible. We came to London for a holiday, not to spend our time endlessly queuing at the hotel.
Thirdly, we parked our car in the car park downstairs. When we asked reception about parking charges, the staff refused to provide any useful information and claimed they knew nothing about it, saying it was not the hotel’s own car park and we had to look it up ourselves.
However, clear signs directing Hilton guests to this car park are displayed there. It is obvious that this car park is intended for Hilton guests. It is unbelievable that staff working here claim to know nothing about the parking fees. This felt like deliberate obstruction to guests.
Is this the service Hilton is famous for? If this is the standard, I will never book a Hilton property again.

Absolutely terrible experience at Hilton London Metropole. This was easily one of the worst hotel stays I’ve ever had.

The room smelled so strongly of sewage that I genuinely felt like I was sleeping in a sewer. The smell was disgusting and completely unacceptable for a hotel of this standard.

To make matters worse, a fixture in the room literally fell off the wall. The check-in system downstairs also failed, leaving us waiting in line for an entire hour just to check in.

And it didn’t end there. We were staying for two nights, but our room key card stopped working after just one day. When we went downstairs to get it fixed, we were told to queue all over again instead of being helped directly.

For a hotel carrying the Hilton name, this level of service and basic maintenance is simply unacceptable. Poor room condition, disgusting sewage smells, a failed check-in system, an hour-long queue, and a key card that stopped working after one day — followed by another ridiculous wait just to get it fixed.

I would absolutely not recommend this hotel. Save yourself the frustration and stay somewhere else.

reviews.text:
Disappointing experience — not what I expect from a 4-star hotel

Unfortunately, our stay at Hilton London Metropole was quite disappointing. One of the lights in the room, right in front of the mirror, was not working, and the bathroom exhaust fan was also broken, leaving the bathroom damp and humid after every shower.

What was particularly frustrating was that we had to contact the hotel twice to ask them to fix these issues, and despite this, they were still not resolved during our stay. For a four-star hotel, I expected a much higher standard of maintenance and, above all, better attention to a basic guest request.

On top of that, the hotel’s location is not in an area that feels particularly “London” or charming, which further detracted from the overall experience.

Overall, it was a disappointing stay, and unfortunately, I would not recommend this hotel. Avoid it if you expect the standard and service you would normally associate with a 4-star Hilton.

reviews.text: This Hilton is one of the largest hotels in central London, with more than 1,000 rooms, so expect it to be pretty busy. The location is probably its biggest advantage, Edgware Road station is about a 5-minute walk away, and Paddington, Hyde Park, and Oxford Street are all within easy reach, with good Underground connections to Heathrow as well. Extremely disappointing experience at Hilton London Metropole.

The hotel was extremely noisy during sleeping hours, with ongoing construction, drilling, and electrical equipment noises. Even when we put up the “Do Not Disturb” sign, our privacy was not respected.

The housekeeping service was also very poor, and the room was not properly cleaned.

The attitude of some staff members was unacceptable. One Arabic-speaking employee even shouted at me and told me, “Don’t come to me and ask for anything,” which was extremely rude and unprofessional.

The elevators were another major issue. Most of them were constantly out of service or breaking down, making it very difficult to get around the hotel.

Overall, this was a very disappointing stay. The noise, lack of privacy, poor housekeeping, rude staff, and constantly malfunctioning elevators made the experience extremely unpleasant. I expected a much higher standard from Hilton

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.text: Stayed here many times over the past 20 years and it's always been a good, not crazy priced London spot in a great location. They had some elevators out of service this time and with a room in the tower that was more than a little annoying. Based on status I was moved to a room on a lower floor which was great. Rooms now all seem to be refurbished and are very nice. This was a rare non-working stay over a weekend and the highlight by far was the Executive Lounge Manager Gib. He's a real star and would not be out of place in any property delivering 5 star levels of customer service.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.text:
As a Diamond member who stays here once or twice a month, these are not isolated incidents but recurring problems that have become increasingly frustrating.

Housekeeping repeatedly fails to respect the “Do Not Disturb” sign. Even when a late checkout has been confirmed and guaranteed, they still knock on the door and make you feel rushed to vacate the room.

The Diamond Priority line at the lobby is equally pointless when there is no proper queue management. On many occasions, the general queue has moved considerably faster while Diamond guests were left waiting. You may as well merge the two queues if no priority is actually given. Digital check-in is not a solution either, as Diamond members are frequently told to visit the front desk if they wish to enquire about an upgrade.

The Executive Lounge has also deteriorated significantly. Serving drumsticks with plain rice as evening canapés is frankly embarrassing for a Hilton of this category. Even my workplace canteen serves food that looks more appetising.

The bathrooms have persistent ventilation problems. Steam is not extracted effectively, and the ceiling can become soaking wet from condensation after just ten minutes in the shower. The showerheads also never appear to be descaled properly.

The hotel’s room categorisation has become increasingly questionable. The original King London View Rooms appear to have been reassigned to the Executive category despite no meaningful change to the rooms themselves. Some former standard King Rooms have also seemingly been placed within the Deluxe category. Calling a room “Deluxe” or presenting it as an upgrade when its windows look directly onto an enclosed service area and air-conditioning units, as shown in the attached photo, is difficult to take seriously. Reclassifying existing rooms under higher categories without delivering a genuinely better room or outlook feels unfair to guests paying a premium.

Finally, requesting basic additional amenities such as towels, pillows or toiletries is often an ordeal. They may take hours to arrive after repeated chasing, or never arrive at all. Reaching the operator in the evening is also difficult, with callers regularly placed at position ten or higher in the queue.

Although the refurbished rooms represent a substantial improvement, the hotel seems to have lost its soul since the pandemic. Long gone are the days when the lounge served afternoon tea with warm scones and finger sandwiches, followed by soup, warm rolls and a small hot buffet in the evening.

The hotel has a good location and I have returned frequently, but loyalty should not mean having to tolerate the same service failures repeatedly. The overall experience now falls well below what regular guests and Diamond members should reasonably expect.

This was my first stay at the London Hilton Metropole, and overall I had a very good experience.

The location is excellent and very convenient for getting around London, which was one of the biggest positives for me. The hotel is very large and can get quite busy, especially around the lobby and common areas. There was also some noise at night, so light sleepers may want to keep that in mind.

Breakfast was good, with a nice variety of options to choose from. Cleanliness was generally okay, although I felt there was still some room for improvement in this area.

The staff experience was generally good. Most of the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my stay. During my six-night stay, I only had two occasions where the level of service was not as good as I would have expected. However, on both occasions, another professional staff member stepped in and handled the situation perfectly, which I really appreciated. Aside from those two experiences, the service was good for the rest of my stay.

I also felt the hotel offered good value for money, especially considering the location, facilities, and overall experience.

Overall, I really enjoyed my first stay at the London Hilton Metropole. Despite a few areas that could be improved, I had a positive experience.

Overall, a decent property with a few notable areas that could be improved.

The room was smaller than average for a hotel of this category, although it was reasonably comfortable. The main lift serving the wing I was staying in was not operational, which meant taking a fairly long route to and from the room. The lift lobbies are also fully carpeted, making it quite difficult to drag luggage around.

The biggest disappointment, however, was the breakfast experience. Guests had to be seated by a member of staff, which resulted in a surprisingly long queue. I waited for more than 20 minutes to be seated, despite there being plenty of empty tables available in the dining area. This felt unnecessarily inefficient, particularly during a busy morning.

The location also has a drawback if you are travelling with luggage or have accessibility requirements. Edgware Road is the closest Tube station, but it is not wheelchair accessible and does not have a lift, making it quite challenging if you have heavy bags.

Overall, a decent property with good potential, but the room size, lift access, breakfast seating process and nearby Tube accessibility are areas that could significantly improve the guest experience.
